The complete source three-panel graph is contained on page 7, in original left-to-right panel order with unmirrored axes.
The three static source icons remain inline on page 6; they are not represented as operative controls.
All 16 reviewer lines and both author affiliations appear on page 9.
The Urdu/English glossary bridge remains distinct from source text; the corrected binomial-theorem bridge appears on page 11.
The 360-pixel mobile reader reflows without document-level horizontal overflow; the graph alone offers its deliberate local scroller.

limitations: Visual review does not certify native terminology consensus or assistive-technology behavior.
